public.text: The description of ArchiMate is appropriate for enterprise architects but may be excessive for policymakers, programme managers, donors, and procurement teams. The existing reading guide marks this section as optional for most non-technical readers, but the chapter does not provide a non-technical summary before introducing the modelling language.
public.suggestedRevision: Add a brief “What non-technical readers need to know” box explaining that the formal model provides consistent naming, traceability, comparison, and conformance checking. Retain the detailed ArchiMate explanation for technical readers.
